results.query: Tell me about the Atal Pension Yojana
results.answer: The Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is an old age income security scheme targeted primarily at the poor, under‑privileged, and workers in the unorganized sector. It is open to savings‑bank account holders aged 18 to 40 years who are not income‑tax payers. Subscribers contribute a prescribed amount—through auto‑debit from their savings account—every month, quarter, or half‑year until they reach 60 years. After 60 years, subscribers receive a guaranteed minimum pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month, with the spouse entitled to the same amount upon the subscriber’s demise. The scheme also allows voluntary exit before 60 years, in which case only the contributions plus accrued income (excluding government co‑contribution for early‑joining subscribers) are refunded. APY is managed by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA); it is accessible via online platforms such as the e‑APY portal, banks’ internet‑banking, or the NSDL website. KYC is conducted through Aadhaar or other bank‑issued documents, and the scheme requires a savings or post‑office account for participation. For more details, you can visit the official portal at https://enps.nsdl.com/e and contact the helpline at 1800‑110‑069.

results.query: What is the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana?
results.answer: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a government‑sponsored social security scheme launched in 2007, administered by the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). It aims to provide affordable life‑insurance coverage to the unorganised sector, particularly those working in agriculture, fishery, dairy, handloom, construction and similar occupations. The scheme covers natural death (₹30,000), accidental death (₹75,000) and partial or permanent disability due to an accident (₹37,500), with an additional scholarship add‑on for the insured’s children in case of death. The annual premium is ₹200 per person, shared 50:50 between the central and state governments, with the beneficiary paying the remaining ₹70. The head of the family or the earning member aged 18‑59 is eligible, and the premium is deducted automatically via ECS or other modes. The scheme is designed to offer financial support to families of the economically weaker sections in case of unforeseen events.

results.query: बीना मूल्य सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजना क्या है?
results.answer: Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana (BM-SSY) एक पश्चिम बंगाल सरकार योजना है जिसका उद्देश्य निर्माण कार्यकर्ताओं, परिवहन श्रमिकों और स्व-नियोजित श्रमिकों सहित सभी असंगठित श्रमिकों को सामाजिक सुरक्षा प्रदान करना है। यह लाभ की एक श्रृंखला प्रदान करता है: प्रति माह ₹55 (राज्य और लाभार्थी से ₹25 + ₹30), चिकित्सा और शल्य चिकित्सा कवरेज क्रमशः ₹20,000 तक और ₹60,000 प्रति वर्ष तक, अस्पताल में भर्ती, मृत्यु और विकलांगता भुगतान के मामले में रोजगार मुआवजे के नुकसान के मामले में ₹50,000 से ₹2,00,000 तक की अवधि के आधार पर, और मेडिकल / इंजीनियरिंग पाठ्यक्रम के लिए ₹30,000 तक की शैक्षणिक सहायता। यह योजना 18-60 वर्ष की आयु में पश्चिम बंगाल के निवासियों के लिए उपलब्ध है, जिसमें पारिवारिक आय प्रति माह ₹6,500 (निर्माण और परिवहन श्रमिकों की कोई सीमा नहीं) से अधिक नहीं है।

results.query: Explain the Airavata Scheme for taxi drivers in Karnataka
results.answer:
The Airavata Scheme, a Karnataka government initiative, aims to provide self‑employment opportunities for rural SC/ST youth through the taxi sector. The scheme partners with corporate aggregators such as OLA and UBER, allowing beneficiaries to operate as Radio Taxis or other cab ventures on these platforms. Beneficiaries receive up to Rs 5 lakh subsidy to purchase a light motor vehicle, which reduces the burden of vehicle EMI. The government intends to cover around 1,000 SC/ST taxi drivers and has earmarked approximately Rs 225 crore for the programme. Eligibility requires the applicant to belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community, be a resident of Karnataka, be above 21 years of age, hold a valid driving licence and a cab badge, and have an annual family income not exceeding Rs 5 lakh. Applicants must also provide various documents such as Aadhar, PAN, bonafide certificate, and others, and undergo training with OLA or UBER before commencing operations.

Key points from the Airavata Scheme: partnership with OLA/Uber, 5‑lakh vehicle subsidy, 225 crore investment, support for 1,000 SC/ST drivers, eligibility criteria including age, licence, income, and community status, and requirement for training and documentation.

results.query: What benefits does the Accidental Death Assistance for Construction Workers scheme provide in Delhi?
results.answer: The Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers scheme in Delhi provides a compensation of ₹2,00,000/- to the nominees or dependents of a registered construction worker whose death occurs due to an accident while employed. This benefit is part of the welfare scheme managed by the Delhi Labour Department for registered workers.

results.query: What documents do I need for the Amma Two Wheeler Scheme?
results.answer:
For the Amma Two Wheeler Scheme, you must submit the following documents:
• Proof of age (18–40 years) – e.g., date‑of‑birth certificate or equivalent.
• Proof of residence – EPIC card, driving license, Aadhaar card, utility bill, etc., in your name.
• A valid Two‑Wheeler Learner License Registration (LLR) or driving licence.
• Income certificate issued by your employer or a self‑certification of income.
• Proof of employment – certificate from the employer/organization/ project head if you are a wage or salaried employee.
• Aadhaar card.
• Proof of educational qualification or appearance for the 8th standard examination – e.g., transfer certificate, SSLC, etc.
• A passport‑size photograph.
• Proof of membership in any priority category (if applicable) – e.g., community certificate for SC/ST.
• For SC/ST applicants, a community certificate.
• For differently‑abled applicants, a different‑abled identity card issued by a competent authority.
• Quotation or pro‑forma invoice of the two‑wheel vehicle you intend to purchase.
Note that the driving licence (or LLR) and proof of age are mandatory at the time of application.

results.query: What is the process to apply for Accidental Death Assistance for Construction Workers?
results.answer:
To apply for the **Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers** (Delhi) scheme, follow these steps:

1. **Visit the DBo CWWB website** and click “Apply for Scheme” or “Register Now”.
2. **Log in** using your Aadhaar number, registration card or OTP.
3. **Apply** for the “Death Assistance” scheme.
4. **Upload required documents** – original death certificate, photocopy of the nominee’s Aadhar card, photocopy of the first page of the nominee’s bank passbook or cancelled cheque, and the FIR/Medico‑Legal Report.
5. **Enter bank account details** for direct benefit transfer.
6. **Submit an affidavit** of the applicant (if required).
7. **Pay the online registration fee** of ₹25 through debit card, internet banking or UPI.
8. **Enter the OTP** received on your registered mobile number and confirm the application.
9. **Note down the application number** for future reference and download the acknowledgement receipt.
10. **Track the application status** on the website under “Track Your Application”.

These steps are taken from the scheme description and application procedure for the Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers as administered by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

results.query: How do I claim benefits under the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana?
results.answer: To claim benefits under the **Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY)**, the nominee of the insured person must: 1. **Prepare the required documents** – a completed claim form, a death certificate (and a post‑mortem report if the death was accidental), a disability certificate for partial or permanent disability claims, and the nominee’s bank account details. 2. **Submit the claim form** to a Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) branch office or any other authorized office **within 30 days** of the incident. 3. The claim will be **processed by the respective state government**, and once approved the amount is transferred electronically to the nominee’s bank account.
